decision: No additional production indexes justified by the current query plans and data size.

evidence.contextScope: Missing session only; permission and state components separately profiled with an existing active principal.

interpretation.remainingCosts: Network round trips, query planning, inherited mutation transactions, and browser polling/signaling.

limits: One read-only profile at current production data size; not a load test.
Directory, inbox and call-state probes returned no matching calls for the sampled active principal.
Combined context was tested with a deliberately missing session, not a real session hash.
The sampled principal had no command endpoint grant; granted-path permission performance was separately proved in internal-calling-performance-20261025.json.
Reassess membership/inbox indexing when persistent call history or measured scan cost grows.
